complianceChecklist.criterion: Business qualifies as Micro Enterprise under MSME Act 2020
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Estimated annual turnover ₹528,000 — within ₹5Cr micro threshold
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: MSME Development (Amendment) Act 2020, S.7: Micro enterprise — investment ≤ ₹1Cr, turnover ≤ ₹5Cr

complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Estimated annual turnover ₹528,000 — within ₹5Cr micro threshold
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: MSME Development (Amendment) Act 2020, S.7(1)(a)(i): Annual turnover ≤ ₹5,00,00,000
MSME Development (Amendment) Act 2020, S.7(1)(a)(i): Plant & machinery investment ≤ ₹1,00,00,000
complianceChecklist.notes: Investment in plant & machinery cannot be assessed from digital transaction data. Requires CA certificate or Udyam Registration.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Upload Udyam Registration Certificate or CA-certified investment declaration

complianceChecklist.criterion: Minimum 12 months of verifiable business operation
complianceChecklist.evidence_source: Agent 02 WhatsApp + Agent 03 Khata Book (timeline span)
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Only 210 days of data — 365 required for full compliance
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI Master Direction - Priority Sector Lending, 2023, Para 6.2: Minimum 12 months operating history for MSME lending
complianceChecklist.notes: Business continuity is assessed using transaction history span.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Upload older WhatsApp exports or Khata Book data to extend history

complianceChecklist.criterion: GST registration status verified (affects Account Aggregator eligibility)
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: CGST Act 2017, S.22: Mandatory GST registration threshold ₹40L turnover; affects AA data eligibility
complianceChecklist.notes: Not mandatory below ₹40L turnover, but absence limits AA eligibility and credit cap to ₹3,00,000.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Register at gst.gov.in — process takes 7-10 days. Unlocks ₹10L credit cap.

complianceChecklist.criterion: Minimum 90 days of UPI transaction history for alternative scoring
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI Digital Payments Guidelines 2023: Minimum 90-day UPI transaction history for alternative credit scoring
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Upload UPI screenshots covering at least 90 days

complianceChecklist.criterion: Business address verified via utility bill cross-validation
complianceChecklist.evidence_source: Agent 01 OCR (bill extractions) + Maps data (if available)
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: No utility bill detected in uploaded documents
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI KYC Master Direction 2016 (Updated 2023), Para 38: Address proof mandatory via utility bill or government document
complianceChecklist.notes: Address verification confidence is higher with fresh bill + maps cross-check.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Upload MSEDCL/BSNL/water board bill. Any utility bill accepted.
complianceChecklist.rm_explanation: Compliance failure blocks approval until regulatory evidence is provided.
complianceChecklist.action_required: Upload MSEDCL/BSNL/water board bill. Any utility bill accepted.

complianceChecklist.criterion: Sole proprietor / firm identity verifiable from uploaded documents
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Owner name recorded at session creation
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI KYC Master Direction 2016, Para 14: Sole proprietor — identity document + business ownership proof
complianceChecklist.notes: Full KYC requires Aadhaar/PAN document upload — not part of current data ingestion scope.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Upload Aadhaar card and PAN card for complete KYC compliance

complianceChecklist.criterion: No wilful default classification in credit bureau records
complianceChecklist.evidence_source: NOT_AVAILABLE — requires external CIBIL API integration
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Cannot verify via alternative data sources
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI Circular DBS.OSMOS.No.12/33.01.001/2002-2003: Wilful default classification requires CIBIL bureau check — cannot verify via alternative data
complianceChecklist.notes: CIBIL bureau check required. Shadow Credit cannot assess this criterion. Manual lender verification required before disbursement.
complianceChecklist.upgrade_path: Lender must run CIBIL/Experian check at pre-disbursement stage

complianceChecklist.criterion: Explicit informed consent obtained per Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Consent hash recorded at session creation
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, S.6: Explicit, informed, specific consent mandatory before processing personal financial data
complianceChecklist.notes: Consent is cryptographically recorded with session_id + timestamp hash. Tamper-evident via audit trail.

complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI Working Paper WPS-23/2023: Cross-validation across minimum 2 independent data sources reduces alternative-data credit assessment error by 43%
complianceChecklist.notes: Minimum threshold met. 3+ sources would improve score confidence.

complianceChecklist.criterion: AA framework eligibility assessed for credit limits above ₹3,00,000
complianceChecklist.evidence_value: Credit limit ₹0 — AA consent not required below ₹3L
complianceChecklist.rbi_reference: RBI Account Aggregator Framework, RBI/2021-22/90: Loan applications above ₹3,00,000 are eligible for AA-facilitated financial data sharing
